Regulatory green light expands sites and supports enrollment, de-risking trial execution timeline.
Sample size suggests potential for meaningful efficacy signal to guide Phase 3 or partnering.
Sets catalyst timing; long runway may weigh on near-term sentiment.
Oral PDE4 approach could compete with existing UC therapies if efficacy/safety holds.
Clinical remission at Week 12 is standard, enabling comparability to peers.

This is an execution update in an early clinical program, expanding trial footprint after prior U.S. clearance. Next, on-time site activation, first dosing in H2 2026, and achieving the H2 2027 efficacy readout would turn this into a major catalyst.
